scope: DEI-T33/T41 state-gate discrepancy for existing implementation receipts
mechanism: Batch and inline single use require_delivery_batch_state; single association of existing execution reaches proof admission without that state guard. Real native SQLite schema persisted a new binding in four states refused by batch.
proposal: Apply existing batch state guard to new single implementation/test bindings, retaining started/in_progress/done, current progress guard, human revocations and exact replay. No gate relaxation or new permission.
decision_basis: DEI9.4 preserves existing preparation and renewal exceptions; BASE10.2/10.4 requires clarification of conflicting actual gate behavior before selecting authority.
limits: Disposable actual native schema; no product mutation.
Neither DEI-T33 nor DEI-T41 qualifies from this reproduction.
Reproduction asserts intended parity and fails explicitly, never counted as acceptance.
